description: Stamp readable page numbers on each page. Distinct from Bates numbering: these are a reading aid (centred, optional "of N" total, skippable cover), not a legal evidence-control device. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists

output.description: Path to write the numbered PDF

position.description: Where to place the number (default: bottom-center)

skipFirst.description: Leave page 1 unstamped, e.g. a cover. Later pages keep their true position (page 2 still reads "2 of 12").

name: pdf_page_numbers
title: Add page numbers
